principle: Pedagogical Core/Full describes lesson depth. Delivery capabilities describe what the product can actually do with the current bound artifacts. Neither dimension may silently promote the other.

capabilities.notes: A learner can open and read the lesson presentation.
The lesson has at least Core pedagogical content and a presentation runtime.
At least one canonical non-reader-quest practice module or practice block exists.
Graded assignment eligibility is stricter than ordinary practice and requires machine-verified-or-higher release.
A candidate quest block alone is not enough; the lesson part must have a bound canonical quest.
A reading claim requires both a bound default reading and ready annotation evidence.
Classroom delivery is available only when the canonical lesson explicitly supports presentation mode.

component_applicability.notes: Part bindings are authoritative for quest/default-reading applicability. Other omitted component states remain missing for capabilities that require them; they do not erase pedagogical Core/Full depth.
